_doc: The lab aide who turns the following Pokémon on and off (notes/FOLLOWERS.md): for saves from before Birch's seventh question, and new saves that want to change their answer. Only in builds with our C on (b2tools/patches/story.py, b2decomp.c_on()). Tile: free in Sapphire's, Ruby's and Emerald's lab, off every scripted path (the door-to-Birch walk x 6, Birch's x 7 and y 8 walk, the rival's (7,4)-(7,5), the Aide's wander x 8-10, y 7-9); the sprite is the Aide's (73), so no new sprite slot.
